description: SANDY, published by luca-fiorito-11, reads and processes ENDF-6 nuclear data and samples perturbations from evaluated covariance information. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Sampling propagates evaluated covariance information; missing or unsuitable upstream covariances are not repaired by the sampling tool. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
